    "n_jets",

        ("exactly_5j", lambda events: events.JetGood.counts == 5),
        ("at_least_6j", lambda events: events.JetGood.counts >= 6),
    ]
)

# B-tag multiplicity binning using multi-bin cut wrapper
btag_multiplicity = Binned(
    "n_btags",
    [
        ("exactly_2b", lambda events: events.BJetGood.counts == 2),
        ("at_least_3b", lambda events: events.BJetGood.counts >= 3),
